name: liao2010
title: Improved local NIR Dunham model of the I2 B-X bands (0-12) to (0-17)
source: C.-C. Liao, K.-Y. Wu, Y.-H. Lien, H. Knoeckel, H.-C. Chui, E. Tiemann and J.-T. Shy, J. Opt. Soc. Am. B 27, 1208 (2010), Table 3 (journal p. 1213)
form: nu = sum_k upper[k] * [J'(J'+1)]^k - sum_(l,k) lower[lk] * (v''+1/2)^l * [J''(J''+1)]^k  (Knoeckel 2004 eqs. 1-2, as the paper states in section 4)
notes: A refit of the Knoeckel 2004 local Dunham model: the same functional form and the same number of parameters (19), with the 27 new comb-referenced frequencies of the (0-12) and (0-13) bands added, and a few indices changed (S30 and S32 replace S22 and S14). Normalized standard deviation of the fit 0.82. WARNING: Table 3 is printed to 3-9 significant digits, far fewer than the 7-13 of Knoeckel 2004 Table 1, and the parameters are strongly correlated. As printed it cannot reproduce its own fit; see validation below and docs/research/nir-model-2010.md.

domain.uncertainty_basis: abstract and section 5: 'an error limit of the absolute frequency less than 0.2 MHz' over 755-815 nm; Fig. 4 (p. 1212) gives the 1 sigma prediction uncertainty per band, below 100 kHz for most (0-12) and (0-13) lines. Section 4 recommends J'' < 140 for calibration and advises against extrapolating below the (0-12) band.

validation.against: the paper's own 31 published components (Tables 1 and 2 and the R(141) 0-16 value in section 2), after the +114 kHz pressure correction its own fit applied; and all 55 v' = 0 components we hold inside the claimed 755-815 nm window
validation.comment: The paper claims better than 0.2 MHz over 755-815 nm from a fit with normalized standard deviation 0.82, so this is a defect of the printed digits, not of the model. Table 3 gives 3-9 significant digits where Knoeckel 2004 Table 1 gives 7-13, and the parameters are strongly correlated: rounding the 2004 table to Table 3's digit count moves its predictions by 15-20 MHz, and a Monte Carlo over Table 3's own rounding intervals gives a 23-33 MHz spread, which covers the observed miss. Nudging every parameter within its printed rounding interval brings the residuals to 1.9 MHz rms, so the digits are consistent with a good model that cannot be reconstructed from them. Do not use this parameter set for positions; it ships for the record and for the domain and uncertainty metadata.
